The multimodal features (image understanding, DALL·E generation, voice mode) are not gimmicks; voice mode in particular replaced our team's "quick question" Slack threads because it is faster to speak a prompt than to type it. ChatGPT still hallucinates on niche topics and can be overly verbose by default, but the custom instructions feature lets you lock in a terse, factual tone that we set once and never touched again. For 90% of knowledge workers, ChatGPT Plus is the single highest-ROI $20/month subscription available.
